RSI remains in extreme oversold territory (23.6), but MACD histogram is worsening (-0.0183) and ADX, indicating trend strength, is at 25.0, marking the early stage of a clear trend. Volume ratio at 0.85 against the 5-day average suggests contraction. The price is at 4.1% of its 52-week high of $2.52, with the 52-week low at $0.99, indicating a continued downtrend.
